## Saint Louis University

### BIOL 1265 — Principles of Biology: Evolution, Ecology, and Diversity Lab
*Teaching Assistant · January – May 2026*

Led two lab sections (~25 students each). Supported instruction in evolution, ecology, and community biology, with emphasis on scientific instruments, hypothesis-driven investigation, and student practice in analyzing and presenting data.

### BIOL 1245 — Principles of Biology: Molecules, Cells, and Genes Lab
*Teaching Assistant · August – December 2025*

Led two lab sections (~25 students each). Supported laboratory instruction in molecular and cellular biology, genetics, and animal physiology — including hypothesis testing, data collection and analysis, visual data presentation, and written and oral scientific communication.
